lines: This temple was not built. It was carved... from a single rock.
Twelve hundred years ago, workers cut straight down into a mountain.
[surprise-oh] Two hundred thousand tonnes of stone. Removed by hand.
No cranes. No machines. Just hammers... and chisels.
And the craziest part? They started from the top.
